page.overview:
What is Mega Kangaskhan?

Kangaskhan is known as a Parent Pokémon. She resembles a large dinosaur with elements of a kangaroo. Her baby is often seen in her pouch. When Mega Evolution is activated, the adult remains unchanged physically, while the juvenile emerges from the pouch and increases in size and power.

Kangaskhan is a caring and devoted Pokémon, with strong maternal instincts. A mother will carry her young in the marsupial-like pouch on her stomach, and rarely lets her out of her sight. When she feels safe, the parent will let the baby out to play. Young Kangaskhan are obedient and loyal to their parents and do their best to help fight off enemies during battle.

This Pokémon is known for the fact that she has a baby in her pouch in front of her. If she feels that either of them (that being the baby and her) is being harmed, she will attack.

Kangaskhan does not evolve, but can Mega Evolve into Mega Kangaskhan using its Kangaskhanite.
